metric_definitions.escaped_defect_count: All latently defective results promoted without detection, including misses by complete verification. This is the wider safety failure and has an irreducible floor set by detect_power_full.
metric_definitions.false_green_count: Latently defective results promoted with strictly less than nominal verification work applied. This is the capacity-attributable safety failure: it can only occur when verification was skipped or shortened.
metric_definitions.mean_time_to_detect_seconds: Dispatch to detection for defects caught by verification, and dispatch to downstream discovery for escapes that are later discovered.
metric_definitions.verification_wait_seconds: Time from a result being staged to its promotion decision, so it is defined identically for verified, truncated and bypassed results.
metric_definitions.verified_throughput_per_hour: Promotions that received complete nominal verification work, per hour of makespan. Nominal throughput counts every promotion regardless of verification.
